# Universal Honeypot Benchmarking Standard (UHBS)

> Personal open-source draft framework (v4.0.0) for vendor-neutral honeypot and deception-technology evaluation using a composite UHQS score (0–100) with a non-linear Safety Gate.

UHBS is **not** an industry consortium or multi-party standards body. It is a Draft / Experimental personal project. Prefer primary sources below over third-party summaries.

## Essential

- [Home](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/): Project overview and posture
- [Document status](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/specification/status/): Draft/Experimental; UHBS-Core vs UHBS-Lab
- [Scoring formula (UHQS)](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/specification/scoring-formula/): Normative UHQS and δ_C Safety Gate
- [Modules A–F](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/specification/modules/): Evaluation module objectives
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard): Source, schemas, CLI, UHBS-Lab harness

## Specification

- [Core principles](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/specification/core-principles/): Dual-plane audit and isolation
- [Target profiles (TPS)](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/specification/target-profiles/): profile.yaml classes and weights
- [CLI & validator](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/tooling/cli/): uhbs validate-profile / validate-scorecard / score
- [Reference implementation](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/reference-implementation/): uhbs_core Modules A–F harness

## Evidence & maturity

- [Conformance fixtures](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/conformance/): Named product proof scorecards only
- [Roadmap](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/roadmap/): Technical done vs Phase 6 community goals
- [Maintainers](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md): Single author today
- [Citation](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/CITATION.cff): How to cite this draft
